description: Prepare Clanker token launch drafts with an interactive Discord card, optional airdrops, and explicit safety controls.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild Clanker API settings and token launch audit records. It does not store private keys, seed phrases, or user wallet credentials.
install_msg: Configure with `[p]clankerset apiurl`, `[p]clankerset apitoken`, `[p]clankerset treasury`, and `[p]clankerset enabled true`. Optional guild controls include `[p]clankerset channel`, `[p]clankerset approvalchannel`, `[p]clankerset requireapproval`, `[p]clankerset allowedrole`, `[p]clankerset blockedrole`, `[p]clankerset cooldown`, and `[p]clankerset dailymax`. Use `[p]clanker card` for the button/modal launch flow. Airdrop recipient rows can generate Merkle roots/proof exports with `[p]clankerset airdrop build` or the card airdrop modal without extra Python package dependencies. Launch requests default to review/dry-run and assign the creator 80% of rewards with a configurable 20% bot-owner platform cut until changed.
name: Clanker
